operation.summary: Wake words: whether the phone is listening, and the wake words the owner gave you
operation.returns: enabled, state (off|listening|hearing|paused), reason, muted_until, model (ready|not_downloaded|downloading|failed), model_name, max_seconds, wake_words[{phrase, send_clip}]. Each hit arrives as a listen.heard event: wake_word, transcript, heard_at, ended_by (pause|max_seconds|no_speech|interrupted), duration_seconds, recogniser, clip_id, capture {capture_id, stored, url, memory_until, file}
